description:
Retro rides again – the Mongoose Miniscoot II has arrived. This blast-from-the-past scooter was inspired by the iconic 1987 Mongoose Miniscoot, and it’s ready to add to your collection. It features durable 4130 Chromoly frame, Pro Class freestyle handlebars, and classic 80s colors and graphics. The white 12" x 2.25" gumwall tires on mag wheels provide a smooth, stylish ride, while alloy caliper hand brakes deliver reliable speed control and stopping power. The Miniscoot II is still 'the most fun you can have a two feet.
Blast-from-the-past freestyle air tire scooter inspired by the iconic 1987 Mongoose Miniscoot. Great for riders ages 8 and up, with a maximum weight limit of 175 lb.
Durable 4130 Chromoly frame with plastic (kicktail) deck will stand up to all your throwback radness.
Hot 80s Laguna Blue color with electric pink graphics add to the retro vibes.
12" x 2.25" gumwall tires mounted to sealed bearing poly mag wheels provide a smooth ride.
Alloy caliper hand brakes and levers with freestyle rotor puts reliable speed control at your fingertips.
Maximum purchase of 2 scooters per customer. Promo codes are not valid.
